repo_notes.content: All code examples and documentation should use "gemini-3-flash-preview" as the model name. This applies to every LLM instantiation example, configuration snippet, and usage demonstration throughout the wiki. For example, GeminiLLM should always be shown with model="gemini-3-flash-preview".

CAL (Creevo Agent Library) is a Python library for building agentic AI applications. Core components include Agent, GeminiLLM, DefaultMemoryEngine, Tool, SubAgentTool, and MCPTool. The package is installed from GitHub: https://github.com/Creevo-App/creevo-agent-library
CAL requires Python >= 3.10. This is because CAL uses the union type syntax (X | Y) for type hints, which was introduced in PEP 604 and requires Python 3.10+.

DefaultMemoryEngine is the only memory system in CAL. It provides multi-layer memory with scoped threads, semantic recall, working memory, and archive summaries. Agent auto-creates a DefaultMemoryEngine if none is provided. The old FullCompressionMemory class has been removed and replaced by DefaultMemoryEngine.
